filters.slice_definition: Declared fixed-edge buckets (edges are caller-supplied, never derived from observed data): (-inf,0)=(-inf, 0.0); [0,1]=[0.0, 1.0]; (1,+inf)=(1.0, +inf)

metric_definitions.sample_count: Number of rows in the slice after all declared filters.
metric_definitions.positive_rate: Mean of the binary target; the slice's base rate.
metric_definitions.roc_auc: Area under the ROC curve. Undefined unless both classes are present.
metric_definitions.pr_auc: Average precision (area under the precision-recall curve). Undefined unless both classes are present.
metric_definitions.brier: Mean squared error between predicted probability and the binary outcome. Lower is better.
